newsitem.title: USA: Key Republicans said to okay $325 mln District plan.
newsitem.headline: Key Republicans said to okay $325 mln District plan.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich and other key Republicans are backing $325 million in tax breaks for the nation's capital aimed at bolstering the city's economy, the Washington Post reported in Monday's editions.
The newspaper, quoting senior aides familiar with the plan, said it would be unveiled at a news conference Monday by House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer, a Texas Republican.

The plan would grant federal tax breaks to thousands of individuals and businesses in economically depressed areas of the District of Columbia. The measure was part of an $85 billion federal tax cut bill that Archer's panel is scheduled to approve this week.
The plan includes a targeted income tax cut and a zero percent capital gains tax rate on the sale of certain assets, the newspaper said.
